description: ChoreStrike Task Templates - Realistic household tasks with appropriate frequencies

templates.name: Empty dishwasher / Do dishes
templates.description: Empty clean dishes from dishwasher or wash dirty dishes
templates.instructions:
1. Check if dishwasher has clean dishes
2. Empty and put away dishes
3. If dirty dishes exist, load dishwasher or hand wash
4. Wipe sink area

templates.name: Wipe kitchen counters
templates.description: Clean and disinfect all kitchen countertops
templates.instructions:
1. Clear counters of items
2. Spray with cleaner
3. Wipe down thoroughly
4. Pay attention to corners and edges

templates.name: Take out kitchen trash
templates.description: Empty kitchen trash and recycling bins
templates.instructions:
1. Check trash level
2. Tie up full bags
3. Replace with new liners
4. Take to outdoor bin

templates.name: Clean stove and cooktop
templates.description: Clean stove surface, burners, and control knobs
templates.instructions:
1. Remove burner grates
2. Wipe surface with degreaser
3. Clean burner caps
4. Wipe control panel
5. Replace grates

templates.name: Clean refrigerator
templates.description: Wipe shelves, check expiry dates, organize contents
templates.instructions:
1. Remove expired items
2. Take out removable shelves
3. Wash with warm soapy water
4. Wipe interior walls
5. Replace shelves and organize

templates.name: Clean microwave
templates.description: Clean interior and exterior of microwave
templates.instructions:
1. Heat bowl of water for 2 min to loosen grime
2. Wipe interior with damp cloth
3. Clean turntable
4. Wipe exterior and control panel

templates.name: Mop kitchen floor
templates.description: Sweep and mop kitchen floor thoroughly
templates.instructions:
1. Sweep or vacuum floor
2. Prepare mop bucket
3. Mop with cleaning solution
4. Pay attention to corners and under cabinets

templates.name: Clean toilet
templates.description: Scrub toilet bowl, seat, and exterior
templates.instructions:
1. Apply toilet bowl cleaner
2. Let sit for 5 minutes
3. Scrub with brush
4. Wipe seat and exterior
5. Clean base and behind toilet

templates.name: Clean shower/bathtub
templates.description: Scrub tiles, tub, showerhead, and fixtures
templates.instructions:
1. Apply bathroom cleaner to walls and tub
2. Scrub grout and tiles
3. Clean showerhead (use vinegar if clogged)
4. Rinse thoroughly
5. Wipe fixtures

templates.name: Clean bathroom sink and vanity
templates.description: Clean sink basin, faucet, mirror, and counter
templates.instructions:
1. Clear items from counter
2. Spray cleaner on sink and counter
3. Scrub basin and drain area
4. Polish faucet
5. Clean mirror with glass cleaner

templates.name: Clean bathroom floor
templates.description: Sweep and mop bathroom floor, clean baseboards
templates.instructions:
1. Sweep or vacuum floor
2. Mop with appropriate cleaner
3. Pay attention to corners and behind toilet
4. Wipe baseboards if needed

templates.name: Change bathroom towels
templates.description: Replace used towels with fresh ones
templates.instructions:
1. Collect used towels
2. Put in laundry
3. Hang fresh towels
4. Check hand towels and washcloths

templates.name: Make bed
templates.description: Straighten sheets, fluff pillows, arrange blankets
templates.instructions:
1. Straighten fitted sheet
2. Smooth flat sheet and tuck in
3. Fluff pillows and arrange
4. Straighten blanket/comforter

templates.name: Gather bedroom laundry
templates.description: Collect dirty clothes and bedding for washing
templates.instructions:
1. Check laundry hamper
2. Collect items from floor/chairs
3. Sort by color/material
4. Take to laundry area

templates.name: Dust bedroom surfaces
templates.description: Dust furniture, shelves, nightstands, and decor
templates.instructions:
1. Work top to bottom
2. Dust shelves and decor
3. Wipe nightstands and dressers
4. Don't forget window sills and baseboards

templates.name: Vacuum bedroom
templates.description: Vacuum carpet or floor thoroughly
templates.instructions:
1. Pick up items from floor
2. Vacuum under bed if accessible
3. Move vacuum in both directions
4. Use attachments for edges and corners

templates.name: Change bed sheets
templates.description: Remove old sheets, put on fresh bedding
templates.instructions:
1. Remove old sheets and pillowcases
2. Put in laundry
3. Put on fresh fitted sheet
4. Add flat sheet and duvet/comforter
5. Arrange pillows

templates.name: Vacuum living room
templates.description: Vacuum carpets, rugs, and upholstery
templates.instructions:
1. Clear floor of items
2. Vacuum under furniture if possible
3. Use attachments for upholstery
4. Move in slow, overlapping strokes

templates.name: Dust living room
templates.description: Dust furniture, electronics, shelves, and decor
templates.instructions:
1. Dust TV and electronics first
2. Dust shelves and bookcases
3. Wipe coffee and side tables
4. Clean decor items and picture frames

templates.name: Clean living room windows
templates.description: Clean interior windows and window sills
templates.instructions:
1. Vacuum window sills and tracks
2. Clean glass with glass cleaner
3. Wipe frames and handles
4. Clean any curtains or blinds

templates.name: Take out all trash
templates.description: Collect and dispose of trash from all rooms
templates.instructions:
1. Go room to room
2. Empty small trash cans
3. Replace liners
4. Take to outdoor bins

templates.name: Do laundry
templates.description: Wash, dry, and fold clothes
templates.instructions:
1. Sort by color and material
2. Load washing machine
3. Transfer to dryer
4. Fold and put away

templates.name: Vacuum all floors
templates.description: Vacuum carpets and hard floors throughout house
templates.instructions:
1. Clear floors of obstacles
2. Vacuum room by room
3. Move furniture if needed
4. Use attachments for corners

templates.name: Dust entire house
templates.description: Dust all surfaces throughout the home
templates.instructions:
1. Start with highest surfaces
2. Work top to bottom
3. Hit all rooms
4. Don't forget ceiling fans and light fixtures

templates.name: Water houseplants
templates.description: Water all indoor plants and check for health
templates.instructions:
1. Check soil moisture
2. Water as needed
3. Check for dead leaves
4. Rotate plants for even light

templates.name: Test smoke detectors
templates.description: Test alarms and replace batteries if needed
templates.instructions:
1. Press test button on each detector
2. Listen for alarm
3. Replace batteries if weak
4. Note any non-functional units

templates.name: Replace air filter
templates.description: Replace HVAC air filter for clean air
templates.instructions:
1. Locate air filter
2. Note size and direction
3. Remove old filter
4. Insert new filter correctly

templates.name: Tidy entrance area
templates.description: Organize shoes, coats, and entryway items
templates.instructions:
1. Put away shoes
2. Hang up coats
3. Clear mail and papers
4. Wipe welcome mat

templates.name: Sort mail and papers
templates.description: Go through mail, recycle junk, organize important items
templates.instructions:
1. Collect all mail and papers
2. Sort into: action, file, recycle
3. Recycle junk immediately
4. File important documents

templates.name: Organize closet
templates.description: Tidy clothes, check for items to donate
templates.instructions:
1. Re-hang fallen items
2. Refold if needed
3. Check for unworn items to donate
4. Organize by category
